title: Settings shell renders only applied surfaces and the profile tab is always active
asA: authenticated principal reaching my account page
iWant: a settings shell whose tabs mirror the union of applied capabilities and whose profile tab is always active
soThat: I can find the surfaces my project has actually shipped without dead links, and I never see a tab whose feature is not wired up

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given an authenticated principal AND an applied auth blueprint declaring principalDirectory, GET /account renders the shell as an ARIA APG tabs region [role="tablist"] with one [role="tab"] per applied capability plus the always-on profile tab; a tab whose capability is not in the applied set does NOT render (no disabled shell). Probed by pack check AC-25101-1.
The shell landmark is <nav data-role="account-settings-nav" aria-label="Account settings"> with a single accessible name; heading order follows h1 (page) then h2 (active tab) per WCAG 2.4.6.
When an unauthenticated principal requests /account, the shell routes to the shared forbidden state (T-1 application-empty-error-states), presents a sign-in link and renders no profile data.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a request for /account without a valid principal on any applied auth blueprint
acceptanceCriteria.then: the forbidden state renders with a sign-in link, no profile form is written to the DOM and no principal identifiers appear in the response body
